title: The last little bounce
purpose: Land the warm resolution and finish on a visual callback rather than a spoken moral.
visual_action: At the open bakery stall, the four share small moonberry flatcakes. Yeti thanks each friend for a specific part of the catch. One overlooked berry under Mara's counter puffs a tiny flatcake into the air. June silently slides the empty basket toward Yeti; he waits for the bounce and catches it without standing.
conflict: A final miniature surprise tests whether Yeti will lunge first or notice the help already offered.
props_out: tiny flatcake caught in empty basket
continuity_in: Yeti carries the empty auxiliary basket from SC-005.
All characters preserve the exact creator-approved designs and restored state from SC-005.
Mara and all market characters remain barefoot or on uncovered natural bare paws.
continuity_out: No new canon facts are established.
Episode ends on the group eyebrow reaction and Yeti's quiet grin.
transition_out: Hold on the basket catch and four raised eyebrows, then cut to end card on Yeti's quiet grin.
